description: R08 Host search family checkpoint: safe Rust closes all 13 Microsoft SearchTests.cpp contracts through terminal-buffer matching plus terminal-host cursor/direction orchestration. ICU remains a native backend choice rather than a semantic dependency of the source contracts.

entries.notes: Literal AB search returns the four row-local x=0..2 spans in forward order and SearchSession advances with native wrap semantics.
Literal U+304B search maps the wide glyph to x=2..4 on all four rows in forward order.
Case-insensitive literal ab matches the AB source fixture and preserves cell spans.
Case-insensitive U+304B search preserves the same Japanese wide-cell spans.
Reverse Reset starts on the final AB result and FindNext(true) walks rows 3→0.
Reverse Japanese literal search starts on row 3 and preserves x=2..4 spans.
Reverse case-insensitive literal search reproduces native result order and wrap semantics.
Reverse case-insensitive Japanese search reproduces the four native spans.
The portable regex subset accepts [BA]{2} and returns the same AB spans as ICU.
The portable regex subset accepts the Microsoft \x{3041}-\x{304c} class range and maps U+304B to x=2..4.
Regular-expression mode plus CaseInsensitive reproduces the native ab→AB matches.
Regular-expression plus CaseInsensitive preserves the Japanese range matches.
A leading (?i) inline regex modifier enables case-insensitive matching exactly as the source contract expects.
